modal.title: AI Content Assistant
modal.prompt_placeholder: e.g. Write a 3-paragraph introduction about cloud computing, or summarize the selected text.

form.tooltip: Fill title, slug, keywords, and content from a topic
form.banner_hint: Fills title, slug, short description, keywords, SEO fields, and the main content editor.
form.product_banner_hint: Fills the website name, catalog teaser, product page content, and SEO title/description/keywords.
form.product_applied: Website content was filled. Review it, then save. Publish on Website is turned on.

form.generating: Generating title, slug, keywords, and content...
form.applied: The form was filled. Review and edit before saving.

form.optimize_tooltip: Rewrite the current title, description, keywords, and content for clearer SEO and readability
form.optimize_banner_hint: Rewrites the current title, description, keywords, and content. Facts stay the same.
form.optimize_product_banner_hint: Optimizes the website name, catalog teaser, product page content, and SEO fields. Facts stay the same.

form.optimize_applied: The current content was optimized. Review and edit before saving.

messages.not_available: The AI content generator is not available right now.
